reviews.title: Great gift
reviews.body: PERFECT gift for my 9 year old! He's been making all kinds of things. Everyday he gets home from school and asks if he can take his clay out. He's even gotten his older siblings (14 and 15 yrs) to join in on the fun. And there is SO many colors and options, the package contained a lot more than I expected for the price and it comes with extra bags so you can save what you don't use

reviews.title: Air dry clay
reviews.body: This clay starts off very soft and drives nicely. Many colors to choose from. The small pouches only contain a little amount that they can make miniature sculptures. Students felt like it wasn’t enough clay however, I thought it was the perfect amount to make a small sculpture for the projects we were using. If someone wanted to make something larger, they could use more than one pouch of clay.

reviews.title: Great variety of colors and lots of fun!
reviews.body: My daughter is having so much fun with this set! We have had it for a few months now and she plays with it all the time, and she and her friends play with it when the friends come over. I love the variety of colors - they can make so many different things! I attached a photo of the mini phone my daughter made to match the big one. It dries overnight and becomes very lightweight. The dried creations won’t last forever; anything too long or thin is likely to break. And if they get wet, the clay gets sticky again. Overall an amazing set of air dry clay and I will definitely buy it again if my daughter runs out :)

reviews.author: Dr. Carole Keim MD

reviews.title: Perfect for crafts
reviews.body: If you were looking for a fun modeling clay for kids, this is absolutely the thing to get. I purchased these for my artistic nephew for Christmas this past year and he absolutely loves them. The kit comes with all the necessary tools and an inspiration book to help get them started. We ended up making an octopus like in the book and then a hamburger!They have great colors and do not stain.  As long as you leave them alone, they will dry like they need to. If you stick two separate colors together, they will get stuck and need to be mixed together. No odd smells or anything..
